top_categories.workout_context: Safari Gravel Race's Rift Valley red-clay gravel, Hell's Gate National Park forces constant power changes. Surge over the rough stuff, settle on the smooth, repeat for 69 miles.
Race-pace efforts that mimic Safari Gravel Race's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before June.
119ft/mi means long efforts at or near FTP on every climb. If your threshold cracks at minute 15, you'll walk the rest.
8,202ft of climbing means repeated surges above threshold. VO2max work is how you survive the fifth climb, not just the first.
At Safari Gravel Race, surges push you above threshold and you have to recover while still riding. Over-unders train exactly that.
69 miles on rift Valley red-clay gravel through Hell's Gate burns energy faster than the distance suggests. Train the fade resistance now.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of Safari Gravel Race. Train it until it feels boring.
8,202ft of climbing on grades that change every minute. You need to switch from seated to standing without losing rhythm.
How long can you hold 105% FTP before you blow? At Safari Gravel Race, that number decides whether you bridge or get dropped.
Base fitness for Safari Gravel Race. Without this, the hard workouts break you down instead of building you up.
Short, max efforts are unavoidable. Punchy climbs, gap closures, attacks on rift Valley red-clay gravel through Hell's Gate. If you haven't trained them, you'll crack.
Low-cadence force work for 8,202ft of climbing. The slow, grinding ascents where you can't spin—you push.

race_overlay.nutrition: Target 40–60g carbs/hour for Safari Gravel Race’s 69 miles. Front-load calories in the first half. One bottle per hour minimum; adjust for conditions and sweat rate.
race_overlay.terrain: Mixed terrain at Safari Gravel Race requires surface adaptability. Include weekly rides on rift valley red-clay gravel through hell's gate national park to build confidence. Expect: rift valley red-clay gravel, hell's gate national park, uci gravel world series.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on Gravel Specific, Race Simulation, and TT Threshold to prepare you for 69 miles of rift valley red-clay gravel through hell's gate national park in Sulmac Village, Lake Naivasha, Kenya.
